short_description: Path of Exile 2 is a next generation Action RPG from Grinding Gear Games, featuring co-op for up to six players. Set years after the original Path of Exile, you will return to the dark world of Wraeclast and seek to end the corruption that is spreading.
about_the_game: Path of Exile 2 is a next generation Action RPG from Grinding Gear Games, featuring co-op for up to six players. Path of Exile 2 takes place in the land of Wraeclast, a dark continent populated by unique cultures, ancient secrets, and monstrous dangers. A sinister threat, long thought destroyed, has begun creeping back on the edge of civilisation, driving people mad and sickening the land with Corruption. Path of Exile 2 features a brand new campaign with six acts, 100 distinct environments, 600 monsters and 100 bosses. Key Features Twelve Character Classes Path of Exile 2 features twelve character classes, two for every combination of Strength, Dexterity and Intelligence. While each of the class variants focuses on a different playstyle, they're just a starting point. You can combine skills from many classes together to create your ideal character build. Each of the twelve character classes has its own three Ascendancy specialisations, resulting in a total of 36 Ascendancy Classes to pick between. New Skill Gem System Path of Exile 2 features 240 Skill Gems that grant devastating active skills and 200 Support Gems that modify their behaviour. Combine these together to create your perfect build. This is the next generation of Path of Exile's famous skill system. Support Gems are now socketed directly into Skill Gems, removing many of the frustrations present in the old system while maintaining all the previous depth. It's now possible to six-link every skill your character uses. Dual-specialise your Passive Skill Tree Path of Exile's iconic Passive Skill Tree has made a return, with 1,500 skills that allow you to completely customise your gameplay experience. It now features Dual Specialisation, the ability to allocate some passive skill points to two different sets of skills. They engage whenever the appropriate weapon or skill type is used. For example, you can have some points allocated to both daggers and traps, or ice and lightning, and as you swap between attacks, the appropriate skill points will apply. This lets you specialise in multiple areas without opportunity cost. Uncover All-new Items Path of Exile 2 features 700 equipment base types and every single one has its own unique item you can find. You can augment your arsenal with new weapons such as Spears, Crossbows and Flails, as well as supplementary items like Focuses, Traps and redesigned Sceptres. Encounter Unique Bosses In Path of Exile 2, every area of the Campaign contains a boss encounter. There's over a hundred bosses to fight as you make your way through the Acts and they all have unique mechanics to learn. Explore a New Endgame Completing the campaign is just the beginning. The endgame in Path of Exile 2 includes countless areas in different biomes, powerful crafting, challenging bosses, unique encounters and much more. Unlock new paths and explore further into the world. As you progress through the endgame, you will gain access to special passive trees that can boost the rewards of your maps and change the way the various endgame mechanics work. These trees will make your maps more rewarding but also more difficult. Path of Exile 2 introduces sequels to several leagues from Path of Exile. While their mechanics are familiar, the monsters, bosses, rewards and progression are all new. Fair-To-Play. Never Pay-To-Win. Path of Exile 2 is a separate game to the original Path of Exile. We will continue to offer expansions for both games going forward. They will never be 'pay to win'. Purchases are shared between the two games.

In the game, you will play the role of Zhen Wu Si's Tiqi to move freely in the Jianghu and the imperial court. The sea of bureaucracy is full of changes. The fate of the world is yours to decide.
about_the_game: 关于这款游戏 Welcome to Nan Sheng, an ancient matriarchal fantasy land teeming with gods, demons, and occasional modern marvels brought in by mysterious travelers. In this whimsical world, you’ll step into the shoes of a Tiqi (elite enforcer) under the Zhenwu Bureau, bearing the Moon Emperor’s secret decree to quell rising unrest among martial artists. Your destiny is yours to shape. Will you exploit your authority to spark turmoil and seize power? Or pursue a path of peace, protecting the innocent? Perhaps you’ll claim the Mandate of Heaven itself. Embrace the chaos in this lighthearted RPG, where comedic madness and dramatic showdowns collide! -Female-Dominant Setting Nan Sheng’s societal structure places women at the highest tiers of power. This alternate reality flips conventional historical norms on their head—expect surprises around every corner. - Male Pregnancy” & Black-Box Biology True to its unconventional world, men can bear children in Nan Sheng. How? That’s part of the fantasy! There is no explicit discussion of anatomy —it’s left intentionally vague for comedic effect and player interpretation. Roam the martial realm, infiltrate political circles, or become a defender of the people. Your actions will influence shifting allegiances—from sworn enemies to star-crossed allies. - Fishing for Fun Encounter 80+ distinct fish across freshwater, saltwater, magma pools, and icy lakes. Some fish can be sold, some are edible, and some are quest items. Plus, you might stumble upon random events or NPC interactions while fishing! There will be three types of seeds in the game. These are regular seeds from the store, exotic seeds sold by foxes, and fantasy seeds. Players watering certain fantasy plants will trigger some random plot. For example, a certain poisonous flower may cause you to fall into a brief hallucination when watering it. - Light COC-Style Skill Checks Rely on dice rolls for certain actions—like using the Listen skill to eavesdrop on gossip. Most scenarios hinge on simple success or failure, though a handful may lead to spectacular triumphs or disasters. - Straightforward Combat You start with decent strength. Switch weapons for melee attacks, summon a mechanical hawk, or toss landmines—simple controls ensure easy-to-learn battles that still pack a punch. - Diverse Relationships Forge unique bonds with multiple romance options including both male and female characters (and occasionally more unusual genders, too) . Pursue pure love, gather a grand harem, or wage a thrilling love-hate rivalry. Each character has their own moral code and might even oppose you—choose wisely. Important Disclaimer This game is all-ages with no explicit content, despite the unconventional themes. All main characters are 18+ to avoid any misunderstandings about age. The focus is on humor, drama, and storytelling over realism or explicit depictions. Additional Considerations Matriarchal Context Nan Sheng is a woman-led society , which may differ from typical historical or fantasy settings. Expect role reversals in power dynamics, social norms, and cultural expectations. Fantasy “Male Pregnancy” While the game includes a “male pregnancy” mechanic, it remains purely fantastical and comedic. We leave it intentionally vague (“black box biology”)—there’s no graphic or detailed depiction. All-Characters-Are-Adults In many regions, an “18+” label implies adult content. Here, it simply means every character is legally an adult ; the story itself contains no explicit sexual scenes. Comedic & Lighthearted Expect a blend of comedic anachronisms, over-the-top plot twists, and dramatic flair. It is not a historically accurate simulation but rather a fantastical, melodramatic escapade. Romance Variety You can romance both male and female characters , alongside the possibility of more unconventional genders. Relationships may remain platonic, turn into devoted one-on-one romance, or veer into dramatic harems and rivalries. Solo Developer This entire project is created and managed by one person. Please understand that updates and replies to community questions may take time. We appreciate your patience and feedback! Embrace the absurd and dive into this blend of martial intrigue, comedic chaos, and “dog-blood” drama. Tricks of Gods and Ghosts invites you to craft your own legend in a land where anything can happen—and probably will!

No longer willing to endure the ridicule, he uses his powerful ability to expose the hidden truths of the five girls who made him suffer and takes matters into his own hands. short_description: Unfairly saddled with crippling debt after the events of Part I, Itsuki Ninomae and the gang turn to fellow student and daughter of a crime lord Kotoko Teshigawara for help. An intertwined web of loyalties and desire awaits as Itsuki, Kotoko and the others fight for justice.
about_the_game: A visual novel, second game of a four-part series. CHARACTERS Kotoko Teshigawara (Voice: Ion Momoyama) A student in the grade above our protagonist at the same school, and the heroine of Part II. Her father the boss of a crime syndicate, Kotoko still has a sense of what is just and right. With Itsuki and the gang in twenty million yen of debt, she hopes to be of at least some use to them, having herself given permission for their business. Thanks to rumors about the daughter of a crime lord attending the school, Kotoko spends a lot of time alone, without anyone she can truly call a friend. Unfamiliar with romance, she puts on a brave front when the topics arises despite her internal unrest. She likes stationery and accessories with panda designs on. Meryl Hathaway (Voice: Nene Arisu) Due to her slight build and indifferent temperament, she gives off the impression of being fragile. However, she proves to have extraordinary skills when handling emergencies. She likes sweet things. Meryl seems to stand on an equal footing with Kotoko, and the Yakuza treat her with the utmost respect. Rin Akinashi (Voice: Cyclamen Kaori) The protagonist’s long-time acquaintance and fellow classmate. A paragon of perfection with good looks, exemplary behavior, and excellent grades, she’s popular with boys and girls alike at school. However, this is merely a mask, hiding the cunning, scheming vixen she really is. Despite having been raised in a wealthy environment, she has an extreme attachment to money, and earns a fortune working with Hina to operate a large scale business of her own. When trouble arises in her business venture with Itsuki, she at first attempts to wash her hands of it, but thanks to Hina's intervention she remains to search for solutions with the rest of the gang. She is meticulous in hiding her own footsteps, and never makes contact with anyone other than Itsuki and Hina. Hina Yorozuya (Voice: Suzu Sazanami) Itsuki’s classmate. Hina has her share of unsavory friends, but is herself friendly and likable. She places her full trust in Itsuki, and the two of them have overcome dangerous situations together. While she and Itsuki are not lovers, they do share a connection of sorts. Currently a party to Rin's business, she also aids Itsuki and the gang in their venture. Tatsuya Yorozuya (Voice: Ii Kinniku) Hina’s older brother. A student at the delinquent-filled so-called “Badman Academy,” he is also the leader of DREAD. Similar to Hina, he isn’t choosy about the methods he uses to earn money for reasons of his own and doesn’t hesitate to resort to violence at times. With the Yakuza at his back, his money-making activities are a far cry from your average student’s. He sees Itsuki as a friend, and Itsuki trusts him in return. Shiori Iida (Voice: Nanoka Osaka) The schoolgirl responsible for Itsuki and the gang being saddled with twenty million yen of debt. The owner of a strong sense of self-preservation, Shiori blames any inconvenient truth on others. It seems she has been attending school as though nothing happened ever since the incident. While she puts on a refined act at school, in reality she is anything but. Koji (Voice: nozoru) A student at Badman Academy and a former member of DREAD. Disappeared after attempting to steal the video from Itsuki. Shoji (Voice: Sho Sakuma) A teacher at Badman Academy, Shoji is a regular customer of Rin and Hina's business. With strong connections to other such regular customers, he actively cooperates with Itsuki and Hina. A basically decent person—despite some of his more 'unusual' preferences. Shinonome (Voice: Cho Koon) An executive in the 'Umon-kai' Yakuza syndicate. In charge of the Umon-kai's criminal dealings, he is Tatsuya's direct boss. Unerringly obedient to the orders of syndicate boss Goro, he is extremely sharp-witted. Goro Teshigawara (Voice: Gunso Hatoman) The leader of the 'Umon-kai' Yakuza syndicate and Kotoko's father. Despite the nature of the family business, he wishes for a normal life for his daughter. STORY Rin Akinashi and Itsuki Ninomae embark on a certain 'business venture' using a video of Itsuki's creation. Rin's business partner, Hina Yorozuya, enlists her brother Tatsuya's aid, and the group gradually begins to make a success of their business, although not without some trouble along the way. However, a certain incident leaves them saddled with twenty million in debt to the Yakuza. Hoping to break free of this situation, Itsuki and the gang make contact with Kotoko Teshigawara, the daughter of the syndicate's boss, with the aim of forming an alliance. Their enemy: A crime lord. Their target: His daughter. Can our heroes survive in the face of overwhelming violence?

Luckily, she doesn’t have to at Yuihime Girls Private Academy, the place where she spends fun-filled days with her precious friends and the senior she loves. Or at least, that’s how things have always been... Now, her comfy and prestigious school is being merged with the boys’ school from the upstart side of town! Shoved into a combined class to trial the new system, she finds her world changing faster than she can keep up—and one of her new classmates makes her heart beat faster too. Quicker and quicker, the changes pile up, altering the landscape of her life like a sudden snowfall... A new love story is about to begin. You're joining a merged class with her this semester, and uh-oh. Guess what you are?

short_description: Build hotels, accommodate guests and expand your hotel business throughout the world!
about_the_game: Check Inn is an addictive game about building a hotel chain and checking in guests! You are about to start developing your hotel business from scratch, from the cheapest hotel in the wilderness. Expand the hotel chain to new cities, buy territories for construction and improve global parameters. More comfortable and expensive hotels have rooms with intricate shapes and you have to carefully plan their placement. Until the room is cleaned, you cannot check in a new guest. The more spacious the room, the more time it takes to put it in order. The hotel is rapidly growing upwards, so it is necessary to build elevators that allow guests to get to their room on the desired floor. Monitor the condition of the elevators by modernizing them and buying new ones to fully cover the growing needs. Build service rooms - kitchens, laundries, saunas and others to serve all the wishes of the guests. Hire porters to deliver ready-made meals, dirty clothes and other items between rooms and floors of the hotel. Try to do this on time, otherwise negative reviews cannot be avoided! In Montreal, the weather is cold and snowy - you will have to insulate the hotel rooms so that your guests won't freeze when the temperature outside changes. In Miami, your expensive hotel with intricately shaped rooms will be located right on the ocean shore. In New York, build hotels in different areas at the same time and hire managers to automate the check-in of guests! After all, it is becoming increasingly difficult to manage everything on your own. The manager will take control of the process of checking in new guests in a certain hotel. Check Inn is a simple at first glance, but an entertaining game that will allow you to immerse yourself in the fascinating world of the hotel business.

short_description: Vanguard Exiles is a new style of Auto-Battler designed by legendary game designer, Richard Garfield, where each player pits their Squad against their opponent in an ever-changing environment.
about_the_game: From the mind that brought you Magic: the Gathering comes Richard Garfield's latest design creation, ' Vanguard Exiles '! It's Your World...if you can claim it! The world has fallen. In the wake of global cataclysm, the survivors have banded together, forming Squads with unlikely alliances to reclaim the land. The only thing missing...a leader to rally their Squad to victory. A leader with the strength to command and a mind with the prowess to outplay opponents. A will of steel that never breaks. That General...is you. A redefining take on both card games and autobattlers, Vanguard Exiles seamlessly blends the two with ease, testing your strategy and battle prowess in your role as General. Both you and your opponent deploy your cards into various Zones on the battlefield, strategizing placement by factoring in the abilities of your Unit and Action cards. Your goal is singular and your orders are definitive: capture Zones to claim their Victory Points. But it won't be as easy as that. Neither opponent can see where the other has deployed until the round begins, so you'll need a sharp tactical mind to predict your opponents' plan and counter their strategy. Always remember, they'll be doing the same, so stay on your toes! A clever mix of mind games, solid tactical positioning, and leveraging the dynamic interactions on the map will give you the edge you need to dominate the battlefield. Blurring the lines between an online card game and a boardgame, Vanguard Exiles expands gameplay into endless possibilities too vast for a traditional tabletop, where each game is guaranteed to be different from the last. Be the first to reach the highest points and claim not just victory, but glory! Single Player Daily Challenges Hotseat PvP Multiplayer Engaging Strategy Dynamic Map Unique Faction pairings Endless Squad Combinations Immerse yourself in a dieselpunk world, where the post-apocalyptic setting has paved the way for alliances once deemed impossible. The enmity between the various denizens of the world has faded, giving rise to the merging of technology and magic. With the prevailing focus on survival and dominance, make use of every tool available to reclaim the land and raze opponents.

about_the_game: Bundling together the classic tug of war games Warfare 1917 and Warfare 1944 , Warfare Legacy Collection contains the definitive versions of these original strategy games. This edition also introduces an all-new campaign, Battle of the Bulge . Engage in the strategic battles of WW1 and WW2, commanding troops and shaping battlefields. Fighting historical battles in and out of the trenches of France, Warfare 1917 sees you play as either the British or German Army in a campaign of attrition. Deploy troops and control the trenches! Hold the line against surprise attacks and push back under brutal conditions. Escort convoys, clear minefields, and capture key crossroads. Face new mission types built exclusively for this campaign. A brand-new chapter, fully original to the Legacy Collection.

short_description: A dystopian simulator where your choices shape a decaying city. Join other players to protect the metropolis from ruin, hasten its downfall, or simply work in the factories. With no set goals or rules, every action has consequences in a world teetering on the brink.
about_the_game: Enter ANEURISM IV , a sprawling metropolis where the proletariat works without question and the air is thick with decay. As a Spirit —a spectral entity on the verge of becoming flesh and bone—you stand at a crossroads. The city is yours to influence, disrupt, or simply observe. With no set goals or rules, how you engage with this world is entirely up to you. From the hardworking Prole to the affluent Banker , each fate offers unique abilities, challenges, and ways to interact with the city and its inhabitants. Your choice defines your journey: Align with the Cortex to stabilize and protect the city. Join the Scumbags or Zealots to spread the Rot and sow chaos. Remain Neutral and immerse yourself in daily life, working in factories or exploring the city. An ever-present threat, the Rot visibly alters the city as it spreads. Roles like Liquidators and Scumbags are pivotal in either containing or exploiting this menace. If left unchecked, the Rot will consume everything, leading to the city's demise. A Living, Breathing City ANEURISM IV is a sandbox simulator first and foremost. The city reacts dynamically to player actions: Take Down the City : Collaborate with others to bring about the city's downfall and witness its reset. Protect the City : Work to maintain order and keep the Rot at bay. Live Your Life : Engage in everyday activities or carve out a unique path—it's your choice. Survival depends on your willingness to work. Earn credits by taking on various jobs—labour in factories, manage resources as a Prole, or manipulate finances as a Banker. These credits are your lifeline, allowing you to purchase necessities from shops, trade for valuable goods, or invest in property. No Rules, Only Consequences In ANEURISM IV , there are no rules dictating your actions. Every decision you make impacts the city and its inhabitants. Will you bring stability or chaos? The choice is yours. Key Features Total Freedom : No imposed objectives. Play your way. Dynamic Consequences : Every action influences the world around you. Multiplayer Interaction : Invite friends to join your world—collaborate, compete, or coexist. Survival Mechanics : Manage your nourishment and sanity in an oppressive, ever-changing environment. Activities Wait for rations Craft goods Rent property Listen to the radio Work in a factory Do laundry Earn credits Pay taxes Evade the Cortex for tax evasion Go insane Eat suspicious things

short_description: Welcome to Caminora! Immerse yourself in the authentic police work of the American Highway Patrol. Solve cases, chase criminals and explore the open-world. Choose your officer and tackle the everyday life on the highways. Will you be able to maintain law and order?
about_the_game: Introducing Highway Police Simulator: Dive into the action of American patrolling duty! Put on your uniform and step into the shoes of an American police officer with Highway Police Simulator ! This game brings the heart-pounding action of the American Highway Patrol right to your fingertips. Immerse yourself in the unique challenges and serious police duties that officers face on a daily basis and truly feel what it's like to patrol the highways while maintaining law and order. A compelling police story awaits you, with the option to play as either a male or a female officer. With both a casual and a simulation gameplay modes, Highway Police Simulator combines the best of both worlds: the freedom to drive and walk in an immersive virtual environment, and a diverse variety of exciting cases to solve in story-driven gameplay. Explore a diverse open world and tackle any situation that comes your way with an array of vehicles including cars, helicopters, and more. Welcome to Caminora, where new missions await you! Get ready to experience the thrill of the chase, the satisfaction of solving crimes, and the adrenaline rush of patrolling the highways. What kind of cop will you be? Will you uphold the law with integrity, or will you bend the rules to get the job done? Your decisions will have a real impact on the story and the environment. Highway Police Simulator is where YOUR story begins! Key Features Authentic American Setting : Freedom to patrol the highways and urban landscapes of the fictional US region of Caminora in a diverse open-world environment. Story-driven Gameplay : Solve exciting criminal cases that require you to make critical decisions. Use training grounds to climb up the ranks and successfully complete assignments to advance in your career and ultimately become the best officer in town. Unlock new tools and vehicles to aid you in your quest for justice. Unique Vehicles : Drive highly detailed special vehicles such as different police cars, helicopters and more. Various Missions : Investigate accident scenes, talk to the people involved, document the accident, collect evidence, and draw conclusions by interpreting all the information you have gathered so far. Inspect vehicles at traffic stops and ensure safe roads for citizens. Chase down criminals through traffic chaos in thrilling pursuits and test your skills as you navigate the streets in dynamic car chases. Choose to approach missions in a strategically way and act calmly and cautiously or engage in shootouts where quick thinking and precision are the keys to success. Morality System : Are you a good and righteous cop or do you like to bend the law from time to time? Either way, your choices will affect not only the outcome of the story, but also the environment in which you live. Do as you please and live with the consequences.

Stalk the shadows as the tension builds, then run for cover as the shots start flying in a volley of muzzle flashes. Think you've got what it takes to eliminate the competition in Blindfire? Then grab your weapon and LIGHT THEM UP .

short_description: A survival horror mixed with found footage elements. Unveil the secrets of a dark satanic cult and solve the Solomon Manor puzzles while hiding from the deadly Goat Face.
about_the_game: Whispers of a shadowy satanic cult connected to dozens of missing people have ignited a firestorm of rumors. Some believe the tales are true, while others dismiss them as a hoax. In the wake of a brutal wave of journalist layoffs, Sarah is ready to chase the story no one else dares touch. But as she digs deeper into the horrifying mystery, she’ll soon realize that risking her life for that one shot may be the worst mistake she’s ever made. A DIRTY JOB BUT SOMEONE HAS TO DO IT Discover the secrets that lie behind the walls of the Solomon manor in this obscure third person survival horror made by the creators of The Night of the Scissors and Cannibal Abduction , inspired by the satanic panic from the 80s and found footage movies. Experience the fear of being locked with the deadly Goat Face. Find places to hide... Or fight back, if you dare. Interview Black Hill's locals and record as much footage as you can in the free view first person mode. A huge victorian manor to explore, every room is full of interactions, items to collect, things to record, secrets and puzzles. Blow the candles that light the devil shrines for saving your progress, but there's a catch... The manor will become darker every time you do it! Cinematic camera angles and authentic VHS glitches. Learn about the Architect's secrets and discover an incredible plot twist! Contemplate the most horrific creations in an ingame gallery art. Every piece you see was painted by real horror artists! MULTIPLE GAME MODES! Enjoy a classic tense survival horror experience that will keep you on the edge of your seat, or pick the scary mode for an experience full of loud jumpscares. Up to a real challenge? Opt for the Deadly mode, which features a more lethal enemy and the key to unlock and even harder difficulty! Disclaimer: This game is an experience meant for players 18 years and over. The base content is estimated to be finished in ~5 hours. Keep this in mind before acquiring the product.

short_description: Airships: Lost Flotilla is a steampunk autoshooter where you fight your way through waves of enemies on your way to a safe harbour. Destroy your foes, harvest wreckage, and upgrade your ship.
about_the_game: Your fleet was betrayed and your airship barely escaped destruction. Now fight your way past waves of pirates, cultists, and sky monsters. Destroy your foes, harvest wreckage, upgrade your ship, and find your way to safety. A Menagerie of Monsters Engage enemies with different attack patterns and abilities. Fight massive boss monsters that require cunning and firepower to defeat. An Array of Airships Pick the slow but powerful Battleship, the nimble Copter, or the Science Vessel with its railgun and energy shield. Build a strategy around their strengths and weaknesses. Don't feel the need to ever stop? The Megaplane will suit you. Want to build a mighty fleet? Start with the Flagship. Path Planning Choose where your fleet goes on its journey. Different destinations have pros and cons in terms of what enemies you fight, the rewards you get, the available upgrades, and your relationships with local factions. For example, you can befriend cultists, gaining their Worm Blessings and their aid in future battles. A Panoply of Powerups Equip your ship with cannons, rockets, aerial torpedoes, mines, gatling guns, and more. Strengthen it with modules like ammo elevators, guard barracks, command posts. Host strange temples. Improve your ship with training for your crew, more armor plating, or senior officers. Pick a doctrine to gain its advantages: terrify your enemies, dodge incoming attacks, make your money through trade. Find powerful combinations that lay waste to your enemies. Charismatic Captains Unlock captains for your ship that give you powerful advantages and disadvantages and change the rules of your game. Strange Stelae Temples and monoliths as well as more familiar ports float in the skies, changing the game rules in parts of the map. Disadvantage your enemies and boost your abilities with careful positioning.

It combines action and strategy in a fusion of intense gunplay with turn-based combat, item crafting and a deep skill system. Each bullet shot, each grenade thrown and each step taken will count towards failure or success. EXPLORE THE UNDERGROUND LABORATORY On the run from the spreading infection in the city, Beatrice discovers the entrance to a secret biological laboratory. Documents mention the existence of a successfully developed vaccine, sending her on a journey deep into the complex as she becomes humanity’s last hope. UTILIZE AN ARSENAL OF WEAPONS AND SKILLS Beatrice will need to defend herself from the dangers lurking below. Unlock unique guns, each with their own benefits and downsides; use throwables to blast enemies into pieces, blind them, stun them or set them all on fire. Even a strong kick to the face can turn the tide of battle in your favor - time to unleash the power of high-heels in close-quarters-combat! In addition to raw weapon power, Beatrice can learn hundreds of different skills. Every gun has its own set of active skills, for example unlocking the potential of rapid fire for the pistol, using birdshot to hit all enemies at once with the shotgun, or emptying an entire magazine into the undead horde in one go with the automatic rifle. Supplemented by a huge number of passive skills for offense and defense, Beatrice gets access to a growing number of strategic options. FIGHT UNIQUE ENEMIES AND BOSS BATTLES Zombies are far from the only threat roaming the massive, interconnected facility. Dozens of strange abominations can be encountered, from mutated creatures, infested animals and living plants to weaponized machinery and many more. Every stage features a unique selection of enemies, complete with a boss battle at the end. Defeating a stage boss will require clever use of strategy, learning the enemies’ weaknesses and utilizing the right skills at the right time. ENJOY HANDCRAFTED ART AND ANIMATIONS Every animation was crafted by use of traditional techniques, with every frame and variation of motion having been carefully hand-drawn and manually refined. Beatrice’s facial expressions, subtle bodily movements, particle effects and voice overs for every event are meticulously controlled through scripting. ENCOUNTER RANDOM EVENTS: EVERY RUN IS DIFFERENT Meet other characters, open chests with valuable loot, buy stat-altering drinks at vending machines, water strange plants (at your own risk) and defeat thieving little rodents among many other events that can be encountered at random. No two runs will be the same as Beatrice needs to adapt to beneficial and dangerous encounters alike. CRAFTING SYSTEM Unlock crafting to combine items into new or stronger ones. Recovery items and ammunition for a secret weapon can be assembled whenever you are not in an active battle. Plan ahead of time to make sure you have the edge in combat when you need it the most. PICK YOUR DIFFICULTY Different difficulty settings allow players of all skill levels to enjoy the game. Whether you play for the story or the challenge, the rogue-lite system of earning permanent upgrades will make the game easier even after failed attempts - and for those seeking the hardest challenge: Beatrice’s level can be lowered in the later game for that extra dose of difficulty. FULL CONTROLLER SUPPORT AND FORCE FEEDBACK In addition to keyboard controls, every part of the game has full controller support. Furthermore, detailed force feedback simulates hits, kicks, shots and blasts, creating a tactile experience for every action. We recommend giving controller vibration a try for the highest level of immersion. For an especially comfortable experience: The game was designed for effortless navigation with just one hand. Left, right or both hands, the control scheme allows you to play the way you desire.

Psychopath Massacre is a first-person short psychological horror game with a VHS effect. (It's a short puzzle game) Be cautious and observant, because a sinister psychopath lurks within these rooms, hidden in the shadows and monitoring your every step. Authorities in Romania discover a very unsettling record detailing, the horrible murders committed by a single person during a police raid on a home. Approximately 60 videotapes, recorded by the psychopath and documenting the graphic details of his killings , are among the discoveries. Law enforcement teams from both state and federal agencies carefully examine the graphic footage to find crucial hints such as the name of the murderer, the victims' identities, and possible leads regarding his whereabouts. Even after numerous viewings, the tapes don't provide much information other than the terrifying reality of the atrocities. The powerful effect of the gruesome visuals unnerves detectives as they probe further into the insane mind that produced the recordings. After months of investigation, one tape, in particular, draws the attention of the authorities despite the abundance of others . Florentina, the victim , recorded this tape, which unintentionally revealed the identify of the attacker and shows her frantic attempt to break free from the grip of her attacker. Through close examination of the video, the authorities are able to reconstruct Florentina's terrifying experience inside the house as well as the identity of the criminal. With the potential to make significant progress toward catching the offender and providing the victims with justice, this vital evidence acts as a ray of hope for the investigation. George Dinescu imprisons you within his home , refusing to let you go. A pounding headache wakes you up in a dimly lit room, reminding you of a hard blow to the head. Your flashlight, is the only source of illumination. The main exit is sealed behind a series of locks, forcing you to search the house for keys and other items required to unlock the door to freedom. However, caution is advised because the psychopath has acute hearing; any sound, whether a dropped object or a creaking floorboard, indicates his imminent arrival. Beware of his bear traps. Choose from three difficulty levels: Hard, Normal, and Easy. True Survival Horror Experience: You are no fighter, and your only chance of surviving the horrors of the house is to escape... or hide. Immersive Graphics: RETRO VHS quality graphics provide gamers a complex, horrifying environment to explore. Hide & Seek: Stealthy gameplay with parkour areas and hide zones. Unpredictable Enemy: Players have no idea when, or from where. The game has speech recognition, use your microphone to distract the enemy or trigger certain game events. In game shop, beat the game on certain difficulties, earn coins and customize your game.

short_description: Tower of Mask is a thrilling survival horror in the spirit of the 80's dungeon crawlers. The most claustrophobic dungeon in modern times is yours to venture through alone. Hero, face the ancient tower where eerie masked humans prowl.
about_the_game: An innovative survival horror imbued with the eternal brilliance of dungeon crawling In a confined space with no escape, face relentless attacks from masked humans. Use your limited resources and wits to survive this desperate situation! Simple combat system with grid-based movement and free camera control. The only way to survive is to dodge dangers and defeat the approaching masked humans! Adventurers must solve the mysteries hidden in the dungeon as they progress. Only true heroes, possessing both reason and courage, can reach the top of the tower! Main Features Dungeon Exploration Explore the ruins, find weapons and armor, and discover ways to survive. Strategic Combat Grid-based movement is crucial for predicting enemy actions and positioning yourself to avoid attacks. Once cornered, there's no escape. Ancient Weapons Use melee weapons like swords and spears to defeat fierce enemies. The power to save the world is in your hands. Elements and abilities Players can allocate ability points through level-ups and equipment. It's up to you to decide which abilities to enhance. Difficult puzzles Solve puzzles involving switches, pressure plates, and trapdoors. Items and a handy map feature will be helpful. Words of the Unknown Brave: In this age where even legends are forgotten, I heard an intriguing rumor about the Tower of Mask. In that tower, which stands in a place unknown to people, there lurks an evil that heroes should challenge. And those who step in are attacked by humans wearing bizarre masks. I have never heard of anyone who returned safely from the tower. Can I survive and escape from the tower...?

short_description: Things were worse than ever in Banana Republic, a somber island country. While anarchists roamed the streets, corruption was running deeper due to economic crisis and rising crime rates. Bearing these burdens were "judges" who tried to make things right with honesty...
about_the_game: JudgeSim is basically a 2D text-based simulation game. Read cases, examine evidence, talk to accused people and try to find out whether they are guilty or not. Once your verdict is finalized, hand down the punishment according to the law. As you progress through the game, it will become more difficult to access evidence, solve cases and give appropriate punishments to accused people. The decisions you make will affect the story's ending. While it may be difficult to stay clean amidst all this corruption with bribes and threats, we assure you that the rule of law is not a very important concept in the Banana Republic. So rest assured that nothing will happen to you! In the game, litigation issues such as divorce, custody, inheritance and compensation are included as side content. You are free to decide as you wish in these cases, which are based on various contradictions and dilemmas that we encounter in real life, except of course your conscience. In addition, you must manage your money well in the game, keep your expenses under control and don't neglect your family. But don't forget that you also need to keep your mental health. No one wants to be judged by a crazy judge.

short_description: Yuman’s, the player, once solitary home and routine are now invaded by five beautiful women! Each has her unique charm – the 'childhood friend of 20 years,' the 'first love and former idol,' the 'demanding boss,' the 'bold younger girl,' and the 'shy recluse.' Who will you choose?
about_the_game: Plot/Characters [Five Hearts Under One Roof] is a fully immersive interactive video game that simulates a love story with five unique heroines. As the player, you take on the role of Yuman, who has always been home alone. Now, you’ll be running a lively, love-filled boarding house with five fascinating heroines. Who will be by your side in the end? The First Resident: Your Childhood Friend of 20 Years - Mal-sook Go “Are you really just going to be friends with me?” The Second Resident: Your First Love and Former Idol - Min-jung Park “I don’t want to be just a singer and fan with you.” The Third Resident: Your Demanding Boss - Gran Dong “Cute, Yuman, you like things like this?” The Fourth Resident: The Bold and Forward Younger Girl - Eun-bi Go “I’ve come to marry you!” The ??th Resident: The Adorable Recluse - Seung-yi Jo “I’ve been saved.” Which of these five unique and captivating heroines will steal your heart? Or… could it be that your true love lies with someone unexpected? Key Features Immersive First-Person Romance Simulation : From start to finish, you experience the game through the protagonist’s eyes. You’ll make crucial decisions and choices in response to the diverse and captivating events that come your way. This is more than just a simple dating sim – your choices lead to a variety of events and unfolding romances. Rich Storyline : With numerous story branches and multiple endings, there’s a wealth of narrative content waiting for you. Hidden epilogues and bonus videos in each chapter provide a deeper romantic simulation experience. Unexpected choices can unlock new video routes, adding layers of surprise to your journey. Natural Acting and High-Quality Visuals : The charming portrayals of the five heroines evoke genuine romantic emotions, making it feel like a real-life love story. The development team, already well-acquainted with the heroines, brings a high level of synergy to the game, ensuring an authentic and engaging experience. Irresistible Heroines : From the sweet girl-next-door and the tsundere to the shy recluse and the bold go-getter, the heroines come in various charming personalities and ages – older, younger, and peers. Each one offers a unique and compelling love story for you to explore. About Us Hello! We’re Storytaco, an interactive game studio, thrilled to introduce our very first collaboration with 3Y Corporation’s Milk Film team to Steam players. We’ve come together with one goal in mind—creating interactive content that speaks to the diverse desires of players everywhere. From your wildest fantasies to your deepest needs, we’re here to make them all come true through our games! Thanks so much for all your feedback and support. We’re committed to growing and delivering even better experiences for you!

An extension of the Eden metauniverse Eden Survivors takes place in the same digital world as Eden Genesis, but as a video game inside the very universe of the first title. This means that players will play as Leah Anderson and other hackers who have joined an online game, Eden Survivors. The initial release features the following: - 4 pilots with unique play-style - Perk trees with 64 unique nodes - 75 skills - 14 enemy types and 3 bosses Eden Survivors will receive new content and features based on the feedback from the community during its Early Access period. short_description: Have you ever been to the Arctic? Do you want to open a motel in the Arctic? With the company of aurora, blizzards, polar days and nights, primeval forests, and wild animals, can you turn a run-down motel into a landmark in the Arctic?
about_the_game: The Arctic has always been a mysterious place. Running a motel in the Arctic is also a rare experience. Through the Arctic Motel Simulator, we not only want to simulate the climate and changeable weather of the Arctic, but also want to bring an Arctic-style motel management experience. This is reflected in the following aspects: The Arctic is a vast and sparsely populated place. In the game, you will be able to expand the territory of the motel in the primeval forest. It is not easy to find a motel in the Arctic. Motels there often provide many different types of services. In addition to providing various types of rooms for rent, shops selling Arctic specialties and restaurants offering Arctic cuisine can also earn you a lot of money. There are more, including laundries and other businesses waiting for you to discover. We have prepared eight room types for players to discover. Different room types have their own advantages, and players can choose freely according to their preferences. Everyone knows that the winter in the Arctic is very cold, but the Arctic still has its own unique four seasons. We simulate the weather and temperature of the four seasons in the Arctic, as well as their corresponding gameplay, such as: controlling room humidity in summer and managing room temperature in winter, RVs that can be rented in spring, summer and autumn, and Arctic igloos in winter. There are many wild animals in the Arctic, so legal hunting is allowed in many places. In the game, players can hunt legally in the winter hunting season. There are also several types of guns available in the game, and players can choose their favorite guns for hunting. Winter Arctic specialty recipes are also one of the purposes of hunting. Expanding a business can never rely on just one person. In the game, players can hire employees and special agents to expand the business of the motel. Players can train employees and arrange their work according to different focuses. The game is full of various random events, such as traveler partners investigating cheating, police patrolling your motel, health inspections, stranger events, etc. And due to insufficient police presence in the Arctic, the police also need your help in arresting wanted criminals.

short_description: Explore and admire while navigate through eerie, surreal environments inspired by the Backrooms lore. Explore this uncanny world lost in time and get lost in the otherworldly architecture in a world where reality bends and your sanity is tested.
about_the_game: Descend into the Depths of the Unknown A man gasps for air as he surfaces from water—only to find himself trapped in a room of white tiles and endless pools. This is Level 37 , the Poolrooms , a place where the familiar dissolves into the unknown. In this surreal journey, you will explore spaces that exist between worlds—hauntingly empty, disturbingly quiet, and yet strangely familiar. As you traverse these liminal spaces, fragments of a life long gone begin to surface: objects from a forgotten past, memories of a home now lost, and moments that echo through the corridors of time. But this is no ordinary journey. It is the final journey—the descent of a soul lost to water, drowning in both regret and uncertainty. The further you explore, the deeper you’ll plunge into the uncanny, until finally, you reach the ultimate destination: Hell itself. Can you maintain your sanity and escape the surreal nightmare? Mechanics Minimal Entities, Maximum Atmosphere The focus of the game is not on battling monsters, but on immersing yourself in the eerie, liminal environments. Entities are rare—what you must confront is the unsettling emptiness, the echoes of your past , and the strangeness of these in-between worlds. VHS Filter Toggle For an added layer of surreal horror, players can toggle the VHS filter on or off, transforming the game's visuals into a distorted, analog nightmare reminiscent of old found-footage tapes. Exploration-Focused Gameplay You will be piecing together fragments of the protagonist’s life and death, all while navigating eerie, transcendent spaces that blur the line between reality and nightmare. A Journey Through Liminal Spaces The game will take you through four haunting locations, each one more surreal than the last. These spaces are not just backdrops but represent stages of the protagonist’s life, memory, and descent into madness. Level 37 (Poolrooms) The journey begins here, in a place of endless, reflective water. Pools stretch infinitely, white tiles gleam under harsh lighting, and the sound of distant water echoes throughout. Faded Memories An in-between space that serves as a bridge between different levels, filled with fragmented memories of a life once lived. Here, you’ll encounter glimpses of a home, an old neighborhood, and other key locations from the protagonist's past. The Infinite Stairs An endless descent into the dark. The further down you go, the heavier the air becomes, and the more claustrophobic the space feels. Each step takes you deeper into the unknown. Hell The final destination, where twisted visions of the past collide with the horrors of the afterlife. Dark, fleshy walls pulsate, the air is thick with despair, and shadows seem to watch your every move. Inspiration This game is heavily inspired by Jared Pike’s Poolrooms , a vision of liminal spaces that blend reality and nightmare with disorienting tranquility. We've also drawn influence from the Backrooms mythos , particularly the eerie depictions from creators like Kane Pixels and The Librarian , whose work with liminal spaces and unnerving voids shaped the atmosphere of the game. 'The familiar becomes unfamiliar, and the deeper you go, the more you lose yourself.' In this game, there are no clear enemies. There is only you and the places you once knew—now twisted, empty, and eternal. Each step forward is another step down, into the depths of the unknown.

short_description: Return to the soccer field with your favorite Backyard athletes! The original Backyard Soccer 1998 is back and now enhanced to run on Steam. Build your roster from among the iconic Backyard Kids. Kick, pass, and score in this classic game that made soccer fun for everyone!
about_the_game: KICK BACK INTO ACTION Jump back onto the field with the 2nd game from the Backyard Sports Franchise, Backyard Soccer ‘98, now enhanced to run on modern systems. Coach your favorite Backyard athletes to the championship, play a pick-up-game on your favorite field, and listen to classic commentators Sunny Day and Earl Grey. Backyard Soccer ‘98 captures the playful spirit of youth soccer. Play 6-on-6 soccer with point-and-click controls for passing, defending and scoring! Start a pick-up game for instant play or create a coach for League Play. In League Play, select 8 kids of your choice and work your way to the top of each division. If you play well enough to qualify, you’ll compete in the “Astonishingly Shiny Cup of All Cups Tournament” against kids from all over the world! SOCCER FOR EVERYONE Play soccer like you did with friends in your neighborhood! 30 Iconic Kid Athletes 20 Unique Soccer Fields Intense tie-breaking shoot-outs Comical Power-ups Hilarious Bloopers Lively commentary from Sunny Day and Earl Grey Multiple Divisions and Tournaments To kick things off, choose a player and face Mr. Clanky for some penalty kick practice. This is where you can practice this crucial game deciding skill. THE LEGEND CONTINUES Backyard Soccer featured arguably the most iconic video game athlete of the 90s or any era - Pablo Sanchez. Play with the legend himself or choose your favorites and relive what made Backyard Soccer 1998 a cult classic. Game Modes include: Pick-up Game: Instant play! The computer chooses a random team for you and itself and the game starts immediately. Friendly Match: Build a roster to play a single game against another computer controlled team in your division. Spectator: Sit back and watch two teams of Backyard kids face off against each other in what is sure to be an exciting game of soccer. Penalty Kicks: Practice shooting and defending penalty kicks against Mr. Clanky. League Play: Pick your team name, uniform colors, and players to compete in the Backyard Soccer League. Manage the team through a soccer season. The opposing teams are computer generated. If your team is in the top four by mid-season in any division, you’ll score an invite to the Off-The-Wall Indoor Invitational. If you finish a season as a top two team, you’ll move up to a stronger division. After winning the Premier Division, you’ll compete in the Astonishingly Shiny Cup of All Cups Tournament! ADDITIONAL INFORMATION At our core, we are fans first – not just of video games, but of the Backyard Sports franchise. Fans have asked for accessible and legal ways to play their original Backyard titles for years, and we are excited to deliver. Without having access to the source code, there are hard limitations on the experience we can create. As an example, we can’t use the original 32bit code to support modern macOS, as even with an incredibly clever wrapper, macOS can’t execute the binaries. Backyard Soccer ‘98 runs well, looks better than ever, is stacked with Steam achievements to test your mettle, and creates a new installation for digital preservation within the Backyard Sports catalog that allows the next generation of fans to fall in love with the game.

short_description: A horror walking sim that emphasizes atmosphere, tension, fear, and immersive storytelling, all heightened by well-timed jump scares. The game takes place in a village frozen in time, stuck somewhere in the mid-20th century.
about_the_game: WARNING: This video game may potentially trigger seizures in individuals with photosensitive epilepsy. Player discretion is advised. Gameplay Greed Stays Home is a first-person horror walking simulator . The gameplay revolves around exploration and uncovering the details of the story. The game emphasizes atmosphere, building tension, creating a sense of fear, and jump scares. The average completion time is 50 minutes. Storyline You play as a historian and treasure hunter. Since childhood, you've been fascinated by tales of lost paintings, gold taken during the war, and stolen jewels. However, so far, the only things you've managed to find are a few 19th-century coins and other items worth only a few pennies at the local antique shop. For some time now, you've been researching the history of an aristocratic family from the turn of the 19th and 20th centuries, which lost a significant portion of its wealth due to a theft. The family never recovered financially after that loss. Friends and relatives were suspected, and bad luck was blamed. An innocent person was even wrongfully condemned. However, what truly captured your attention were the tragic events that unfolded in the nearby workers' village, nestled at the foot of the aristocratic estates, in the years following the theft—disappearances and other unsettling occurrences. Today, the village is nearly abandoned. You've been wandering the area for the last few days, searching house after house. The few remaining locals give you suspicious looks, but no one bothers you. Who cares about crumbling, ownerless ruins and some lunatic with a backpack and a flashlight? Today is just another day and another house. Maybe this time, your dream will come true, and you'll find something worth more than an old shoe. And if not, at least you'll have another story to tell. After all, having a passion is what matters most.

With every step you take, Liminal Shift pushes you deeper into an eerie, unsettling experience like no other. Key Features In Liminal Shift it's all about exploring. There is no such monsters or jumpscares in game. It's just you and the environment. Listen, feel and find a way through. You can interact with objects around you, allowing you to truly feel immersed in the game. The game delivers an uninterrupted, realistic experience with dynamic transitions; it includes no black screens or loading screens, focusing solely on gameplay and cutscenes. Every sound is almost real; with Meta Sound Technology, listen and explore every detail. Beginning to End In Liminal Shift, everything revolves around exploration; from start to finish, you experience your very own Backrooms adventure, devoid of puzzles or monsters to flee from. Prepare for an authentic Backrooms journey. Witness Everything Liminal Shift takes a contemplative approach to the inception of the Backrooms narrative. It begins in a restful home, but soon, you find yourself within the liminal expanse of the Backrooms universe. This is not just another game about liminal spaces. Liminal Shift offers a plenty of original Backrooms levels to explore, each interpreted through art to evoke a unique sense of tension, realism, and the feeling of being lost in liminal spaces. Will you manage to escape the Backrooms? Or could it be that life within the Backrooms is more peaceful than your normal existence? about_the_game: Laika, an IRL streamer, didn't find much success after nearly a year of content creation. After an embarrassing accident during one of her streams, her chat went wild, and after a couple of generous donations, she noticed her subscriber count went up! With new subscribers needing to be entertained she decided to expand her activities to also post videos, but she needs ideas. Play as Laika, by managing her day-to-day activities. Brainstorm new ideas by going around the city to find inspiration, make videos, interact with viewers on stream, post pictures for your community to enjoy, and build Laika’s community through her social media! Manage your sanity The lower Laika’s sanity is the more activities she’s willing to do. How far you ask? Let’s just say there are few things Laika will let stand in the way of her fame. Change between day and night to explore the city and encounter many events as Laika becomes more daring with her content. Events / Recollection room Laika will encounter many people, from strangers to her fans. Explore the city and hunt down events to progress her streaming journey and enjoy what shenanigans Laika gets up to in her videos and streams. Learn and improve your skills Learn from The Master and expand your skill tree so you can tackle the challenges of a small time content creator with lofty goals!

about_the_game: 剧情介绍 本市女团冠军种子迟菲菲突遭车祸身亡，迟菲菲是安海大学在校学生，自小在孤儿院长大，经过她数年的努力，终于完成了她的梦想。但就在迟菲菲距离梦想只有一步之遥时，突发车祸身亡。” “继迟菲菲车祸之后，同校的尤佳获得冠军，引发大量关注……” 正当我准备去调查尤佳的时候，一封邮件引导我前往沁心湖公园内。而就在那时，我竟然发现了倒在地上的尤佳，这也使得整个案件更加扑朔迷离了起来。 角色介绍 周青： 安海市法医鉴定中心法医，具有娴熟的尸检手法以及丰富的尸检经验。在她身上的某处，藏有着一个代表着罪恶的印记。 陈美奈 ：来自台湾省的交换生，擅长犯罪心理学、犯罪侧写。而在她的背后，是个庞大到可怖的家族——陈氏家族。 陆小棠 ：自小与我一起在大院长大，其梦想便是和她的父亲一样能除暴安良。然而，自从她开始亲手操办迟菲菲的事件后，危险也便降临到了她的身边。 薛雪莉 ：薛氏集团的千金，因好友尤佳的死找到了我拜托我调查。随着事件的深入我们才发现，尤佳的死，可能和薛雪莉有关。 玩法介绍 1.多重玩法融合：在传统视频互动基础上，融入冒险与解谜元素。玩家不仅可 以通过视频对话作出选择，还需通过文本推理和谜题破解，收集隐藏信息，解 锁更多故事走向。 2. 沉浸式叙事体验：游戏的叙事采用章节化结构，主线故事引人入胜，支线剧 情丰富，帮助玩家更深入理解角色背景和动机。通过多角度视角切换，带来更 丰富的叙事层次。 3. 真实感与异域风情：精心设计的场景和人物，增加解谜过程中的不确定性与 紧张感。 4. 自由选择与多结局：玩家的选择将影响剧情发展，游戏内存在多个分支结局。 每个决定都可能改变案件的走向，考验玩家在面对道德抉择时的判断力。

short_description: Neon lights, palm trees, synthwave, '80s supercars speeding down an endless highway... Welcome to the world of Retrowave!
about_the_game: Neon lights, palm trees, synthwave, '80s supercars speeding down an endless highway... Welcome to the world of Retrowave! Listening to Synthwave / Retrowave most people have had this feeling of nostalgia for an era they didn't know or that never existed. The Retrowave is very much inspired by the '80s, but is mostly an idealized futuristic version of the '80s. This game offers the player the unique experience of being immersed in this wonderful world for at least a few moments... In Retrowave you will first start with one car, then you will be able to upgrade it or buy other cars with the money earned at the end of each run. Race your car through different unique worlds! Watch out for other vehicles on the road (yes, even in the future there will be traffic). Retrowave offers above all a visual and sound experience that will delight fans of the genre and will surely make those who don't know it yet discover this wonderful universe... The country strictly manages and protects Winion, and Little Winion grows safely in the [Winion Repository]. Adult Winion is assigned various roles and works. Therefore, it is illegal for an individual to raise Winion. Huh?... Do you want to raise Winion? Ah. Then you've come to the right place. You can also raise Little Winion here. Game Features 5 Winions with unique personalities Unique Winions depicted in cute pixel graphics await you! Cruel Fairy Tale Story If you purchase the illegal program [Raising Winions], you will be caught up in a shocking and cruel story. Something familiar in the meadow. A bug that occurs in the computer... Actually, it's not a simple system error.

short_description: Desktop Survivors 98 is a chaotic roguelite dungeon crawler that unfolds right on your Desktop. Your cursor becomes the hero as you explore new rooms, battle relentless waves of enemies, and collect powerful new weapons.
about_the_game: SURVIVE, EXPLORE, REPEAT Survive against waves of enemies in quick, intense rounds as you explore the randomly generated dungeons. Your cursor becomes the hero, battling against foes in a bullet hell frenzy that tests your reflexes, precision, and decision-making. PLAY ON YOUR DESKTOP Desktop Survivors 98 doesn’t play in a window — it plays over your desktop. Enemies, upgrades, and chaos unfold across your real screen. Whether you’re looking for a quick break or an extended challenge, Desktop Survivors 98 fits perfectly into your routine. With its fast-paced rounds and the ability to toggle the game at any moment, you’re always just a click away from diving back into the action. Key Features Play Directly on Your Desktop : The action unfolds right on your desktop, overlaying seamlessly over anything you’re doing—perfect for multitasking! Cursor Combat : Your cursor becomes the hero, engaging in progressively fast-paced battles against waves of enemies. Dangerous Enemy Waves : Survive relentless hordes in a bullet hell experience that challenges your skills and reaction time. Variety of Weapons and Upgrades : Discover, acquire, and upgrade powerful items as you progress. Nostalgic Aesthetic : Immerse yourself in retro-inspired visuals that capture the charm of classic PC gaming. Take a Break Anytime : Toggle the game on or off at any moment to pause, step away, and return whenever you’re ready.

about_the_game: Gift Collector [ギフトコレクター] - this is a New Year's horror game from the first person, in the Japanese style and genre of walking simulator. Story Every year, with the beginning of winter, you begin to receive a large number of letters. These letters are children's rays of hope for a miracle. You often read a lot of unusual stories and wishes in them. And you need to make each of these wishes come true. On New Year's Eve, dreams come true, no matter how you behaved last year. Because of this, both children with diligent behavior and those who did not do the best things receive their gifts. Gameplay You will take on the role of Santa Claus. Collect gifts according to the wishes of the children. And on New Year's Eve, go deliver them. You will need to act quickly and quietly so as not to wake anyone up. Stylized graphics and high-quality 3D sound will help you fully experience the atmosphere of the game. Features of the game - Walking simulator; - First-person view; - The effect of shooting on an old camera; - Realistic graphics. Attention! The game contains flashes of light that can cause epileptic seizures.

short_description: “Only Out” is a cooperative survival game for two players. Set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland, you and your partner must navigate a desolate village plagued by scarcity and danger. Trust each other, strategize together, face the relentless zombie threat, and uncover the only path to survival.
about_the_game: GameInfo In a post-apocalyptic world following a virus outbreak, human civilization has collapsed. You will play as a lone survivor, struggling to stay alive in a small village surrounded by zombies. The village’s resources are nearly exhausted, with most of the remaining supplies either spoiled or contaminated by zombies. Your mission is to survive under extreme conditions, not only by scavenging for supplies but also by avoiding infection and finding hope for escape amid the relentless threat of incoming zombies. This is a two-player cooperative survival game where you and your partner must rely on mutual trust and flawless teamwork to overcome hordes of zombies and find the only way out. It’s not just a survival game; it’s also a dual test of coordination and intelligence. Together, you’ll face unexpected challenges and devise the best strategies to turn danger into opportunity. short_description: Welcome to a world where you are lost between consciousness and dreams. As you wander the dark corridors of an old hotel, face the games your mind plays on you. Your memories linger like a shadow following you. But there's nowhere to escape... Are you ready to confront your darkest fears?
about_the_game: Limoria A single-player psychological horror game. In this experience set in an old and mysterious hotel, you explore constantly shifting spaces that challenge the limits of your mind. Each time you wake up, the hotel and its surroundings change, confronting you with disturbing and strange occurrences. As the player, you gather clues within the depths of the atmosphere and try to understand the mystery behind the crumbling reality. Explore Your Surroundings This psychological horror is filled with elements that cloud your vision with each discovery. The game doesn’t hand you the story directly; to understand it, you must immerse yourself in the atmosphere and pay attention to clues. Find Your Way Out of a Fractured Mind With each level, the protagonist’s mind will deteriorate further. Discover the exit and witness even more mysteries in the process. You Can Escape Anything but Not Your Memories Throughout the game, your memories will follow you; even if you’d rather not see them, you’ll pay the price of their consequences. Features Walking Simulation Realistic Graphics High-Quality Sounds Dynamic Environmental Changes “Do you want to escape, or do you want to uncover all the secrets? Which reality are you ready to face?”

short_description: Collect and sell geckos. Manage and upgrade your shop. Explore the island, filled with life and secrets. Sell your geckos, or keep 'em as your Pets!
about_the_game: Everything about GeckoShop: GeckoShop is a Sandbox Shop Simulator + Creature Collector , where you manage your own shop, selling all the different varieties of geckos! 'Your dream of having your own Petshop finally comes true. Get cozy and have a fun time collecting and selling lizards, or grind hard and be the next millionare on this island!' You'll have to: Deal with customers , set your own Prices. Keep the store clean and working, or get Employees to do it for you! Explore the small open-world city , with People to interact with, Quests and other things at every corner. Find Shells and ancient Artifacts on the beach to fill the museum , to unlock even more content as you go. Accept Quests from various NPCs on the island. Catch Thieves trying to steal from your shop. Decorate and upgrade your store, however you want. Collect a big variety of different types and rarities of Lizards. You can sell your pets, or turn your Shop into a zoo! There are hundreds of geckos for you to unlock, in 4 rarities. Through opening chests, mutating geckos in the Lab, Vending machines, and through sidequests. Buy and open different Boxes , to get random Geckos from that set, and if you're lucky enough you might even find a Super rare gecko. Upgrade, Decorate and Paint your Shop, however you feel like. Hire Employees to assist you to sell pets and products, clean trash from your store, and catch thieves before they can steal anything. Keep your shop small or upgrade it to the maximum, make a giant warehouse full of rare items and animals. Collect Trophies to display in the Backroom of your Shop, to keep track of your Progress. Explore the City, Mutate Geckos, Eat burgers, Repeat. The City is full of Surprises ! Check out the Lab , where 'Zippy Joe' made a machine to mutate 5 geckos into another one, and with some luck you might even get a Lab-exclusive gecko (very rare, they sparke in rainbow colors!) Go to the Wrenchshop , and talk with 'Bolt' about upgrading your shop, or go to the Paintshop and let 'Doodle' paint your whole Shop. Get yourself a Companion from the Petshop , or race against other geckos! And dont forget to get a Burger from the restaurant next to the Beach ;) Sidequests everywhere! You might want to go treasure hunting, or collect shells and ancient artifacts to keep the museum growing. Or maybe you want to catch fishes all day long and forget about your customers! Sell your fishes to 'Skipper', but don't worry, you'll see in your Collection which fishes you've already catched, and which ones are missing. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- (We are also working on adding Multiple Languages, Full Controller Support, Steam Achievements etc. as soon as possible.)
